Gusty winds, lightning, and small hail will also be possible. - H

fwf.snippet: .DISCUSSION... Surface conditions remain too moist to prompt any critical fire weather conditions through the work week. Wednesday will see isolated to scattered thunderstorms which may create gusty outflow winds, produce localized heavy rainfall capable of creating burn scar flash flooding and debris flows, and ignite new wildfires.
